digest.component_or_area: transition command and ticket state reducer
propositions: Bug close reason is currently validated but discarded instead of persisted; replacing with a bounded enum via --class flag makes the input actionable.
The --class parameter must be required for bug closes and folded into reduced ticket state via process_status so rebar show can query close_class.
Validation of --class enum must be performed at both txn.py transition_core guard and transition_close.py _completion_precheck, replacing bug_close_reason_ok.
close_class field must be added to ticket_state.schema.json as optional and surfaced via explicit _fold_close_class helper in both fork-winner and normal-update branches of process_status.
Omitting --class on bug close must exit nonzero with stderr naming at least one allowed enum value; invalid class values must also be rejected.
